title: From Benchmarks to the Bench: Preference, Correspondence and Selectivity in Bidirectional Drug-Target Screening
abstract: arXiv:2611.26369v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Identifying active molecules for known targets and potential targets for existing drugs is central to drug discovery and repurposing. Drug-target interaction (DTI) models can rank vast numbers of drug-target pairs, but limited experimental capacity restricts testing to a small number of candidates. We compared the bidirectional recommendations of 13 released systems across 711 molecular structures of FDA-approved drugs and 614 human proteins. For the same target or drug, pairs of models produced completely disjoint Top-10 molecule and protein lists in 77.8% and 70.1% of comparisons, respectively. Even where recommendations overlapped, agreement between some systems largely reflected recurring preferences for the same candidates. translated_title: 从基准测试到实验台：双向药物-靶点筛选中的偏好、一致性与选择性
translated_abstract: 为已知靶点识别活性分子以及为现有药物寻找潜在新靶点，是药物发现与药物重定位的核心任务。药物-靶点相互作用（DTI）模型能够对海量药物-靶点对进行排序，但有限的实验验证能力使实际测试只能局限于少数候选对象。我们在711个FDA批准药物分子结构和614种人类蛋白上比较了13个已发布系统的双向推荐结果：对于相同的靶点或药物，模型两两对比中分别有77.8%和70.1%的情况产生了完全不相交的Top-10分子或蛋白列表；即使在推荐结果存在重叠时，某些系统之间的一致性也主要源于对相同候选物的重复偏好。基于79个分子和65种激酶的已发表抑制活性测量数据的分析显示，部分系统能够富集活性候选物，但当推荐结果与不同药物或……（原摘要在此处截断）匹配时，其命中率变化甚微。
tldr: 该研究对13个已发布的药物-靶点相互作用模型进行了大规模双向基准比较，发现不同模型给出的Top-10推荐列表在77.8%（分子）和70.1%（蛋白）的对比中完全不相交，且系统间的一致性主要反映对相同候选物的重复偏好而非真实的对应关系，实验验证进一步表明仅部分模型能够富集活性化合物且选择性有限。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarked 13 released DTI models for bidirectional drug-target screening, revealing that model pairs produced completely disjoint Top-10 molecule and protein lists in 77.8% and 70.1% of comparisons, that inter-system agreement largely reflects recurring preferences for the same candidates rather than genuine correspondence, and that only some systems enrich active compounds with limited selectivity upon experimental validation.
